name: Neev Check
promise: 40 checks on a project before you sign. What we check, where we checked it, and on what date. Every result is one of four: clear, ask about this, stop, or not checked yet.
whoNote: Which checks are done by an advocate and which by the PropBillions team is to be confirmed. Until then, legal checks are marked 'advocate' and are not shown as a legal opinion.

groups.name: Registration
checks: RERA completion date and any extensions
Quarterly progress updates filed on time
Complaints and orders against the project
Status of the promoter's other registered projects

groups.name: Land and title
checks: Mortgages and charges on the land
Land use matches the project type

groups.name: Approvals
checks: Sanctioned building plan matches the brochure
Height and other clearances where relevant

groups.name: Developer
checks: Delivery history: promised vs actual dates
Separate RERA account for buyer money
Who holds the project loan charge

groups.name: The home itself
checks: RERA carpet area vs super area loading
Floor plan matches the sanctioned plan
Light, view and orientation as promised

groups.name: Money
checks: GST rate on the tax invoice
Payment plan vs construction stage (10% rule)

groups.name: Agreement
checks: Builder-buyer agreement vs the state's model agreement
Delay penalty is equal for both sides
Possession date in the agreement matches RERA

groups.name: Location and resale
checks: Our own drive and metro timing
Resale listings and how fast they sell

sample.label: Sample report. Fictional project, real format.
results: Checked on the state RERA portal, 5 Nov 2026
Completion date extended once, from Dec 2026 to Jun 2027
No charge on the land other than the disclosed project loan
Brochure shows a clubhouse pool not in the sanctioned plan
Last 3 projects delivered within 6 months of the RERA date
Super area 1,850 sq ft; RERA carpet area 1,342 sq ft (38% loading)
All-in cost ₹1.62 Cr against a brochure price of ₹1.45 Cr
35% asked within 30 days, before the agreement is registered
Buyer pays 18% on delays; developer pays 9%
34 minutes to the nearest metro at 9 am, measured
sample.verdict: Do not pay the second instalment until the agreement is registered. Ask for the pool in writing or a price cut. Everything else is reasonable.
